places.name: Old Havana (Habana Vieja, UNESCO)
places.ai_summary: Old Havana is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, known for its well-preserved colonial architecture, cobblestone streets, and vibrant plazas.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored during daylight hours.

places.place_tip: Take a guided tour to learn about the history and architecture.

places.name: Malecón Seaside Promenade
places.ai_summary: The Malecón is a famous seaside promenade in Havana, offering stunning ocean views, vibrant street life, and a glimpse into Cuban culture.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during sunset for a magical experience.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera to capture the stunning views of the ocean.

places.name: Plaza Vieja
places.ai_summary: Plaza Vieja is a historic square in Old Havana, surrounded by colorful colonial buildings, cafes, and art galleries.

opening_hours.notes: Ideal for a leisurely stroll or a coffee break.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a coffee at one of the nearby cafes.

places.name: Plaza de la Catedral & Cathedral of Havana
places.ai_summary: Plaza de la Catedral is a beautiful square in Old Havana, featuring the stunning Cathedral of Havana, a masterpiece of Baroque architecture.

opening_hours.notes: The cathedral is open to visitors, but check for mass times.

places.place_tip: Attend a mass or concert for a unique experience.
places.address: Plaza de la Catedral, Havana, Cuba

places.name: Plaza de Armas & El Templete
places.ai_summary: Plaza de Armas is the oldest square in Havana, featuring historic buildings, the Castillo de la Real Fuerza, and the beautiful El Templete.

opening_hours.notes: El Templete is a small chapel, check for visiting hours.

places.place_tip: Visit the nearby Palacio de los Capitanes Generales.

places.name: Castillo de la Real Fuerza
places.ai_summary: Castillo de la Real Fuerza is a historic fortress in Havana, offering panoramic views of the city and the harbor.

opening_hours.notes: Check for cannon firing times.

places.place_tip: Explore the museum inside the fortress.
places.address: Castillo de la Real Fuerza, Havana, Cuba

places.name: Capitolio (El Capitolio)
places.ai_summary: El Capitolio is an iconic building in Havana, resembling the U.S. Capitol, and houses the Cuban National Assembly.

opening_hours.notes: Check for guided tour availability.

places.place_tip: Visit the nearby Museum of the Revolution.

places.name: Gran Teatro de La Habana
places.ai_summary: The Gran Teatro de La Habana is a magnificent theater in Havana, known for its stunning architecture and cultural performances.

opening_hours.notes: Check performance schedule and book tickets in advance.

places.place_tip: Dress elegantly for evening performances.

places.ai_summary: The Museo de la Revolución is a museum in Havana, dedicated to the history of the Cuban Revolution.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours are available in multiple languages.

places.place_tip: Take a guided tour for in-depth knowledge.

places.ai_summary: Calle Obispo is a famous street in Havana, known for its vibrant atmosphere, shops, and cafes.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored on foot, beware of pickpockets.

places.place_tip: Try the local street food from vendors.

places.ai_summary: The Havana Club Rum Museum offers a deep dive into the history and production of Cuba's most famous spirit.

opening_hours.notes: Includes a rum tasting session.

places.place_tip: Purchase rum at the museum shop for souvenirs.
places.address: Havana Club Rum Museum, Havana, Cuba

places.ai_summary: FAC is a contemporary art space in Havana, featuring rotating art exhibitions, live music, and a vibrant nightlife scene.

opening_hours.notes: Check event schedule and book tickets in advance.

places.place_tip: Explore the entire complex, including the rooftop bar.
places.address: Fábrica de Arte Cubano, Havana, Cuba

places.ai_summary: The Hotel Nacional de Cuba is a historic hotel with beautiful gardens, offering stunning views of the Malecón and the sea.

opening_hours.notes: Visit the gardens and enjoy a drink at the terrace.

places.place_tip: Explore the hotel's rich history and architecture.
places.address: Hotel Nacional de Cuba, Havana, Cuba

places.ai_summary: El Floridita is a famous bar in Havana, known as the birthplace of the Daiquirí and frequented by Ernest Hemingway.

opening_hours.notes: Try the original Daiquirí and enjoy live music.

places.place_tip: Visit the Hemingway Museum nearby.

places.name: Museo Nacional de Bellas Artes
places.ai_summary: The Museo Nacional de Bellas Artes is an art museum in Havana, housing an extensive collection of Cuban and international art.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours are available in multiple languages.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the Cuban art collection.

places.ai_summary: These are historic fortresses located at the entrance of Havana Bay, offering stunning views and a glimpse into Cuba's colonial past.

opening_hours.notes: Check for cannon firing times and guided tour availability.

places.place_tip: Visit both fortresses for a complete experience.

places.name: Hemingway’s Finca Vigía (San Francisco de Paula)
places.ai_summary: Finca Vigía is the former home of Ernest Hemingway, now a museum dedicated to the writer's life and work.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours are available in English and Spanish.

places.place_tip: Explore the gardens and the interior of the house.
places.address: Finca Vigía, San Francisco de Paula, Havana, Cuba

places.ai_summary: Necrópolis Cristóbal Colón is a famous cemetery in Havana, known for its impressive mausoleums and memorials.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours are available, check in advance.

places.place_tip: Respect the solemnity of the site, no loud noises.

places.ai_summary: Parque Central is a major park in Havana, popular for its classic car rides, gardens, and statues.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Take a classic car tour for a unique experience.

places.name: Sunset on the Malecón
places.ai_summary: Watching the sunset on the Malecón is a popular activity in Havana, offering breathtaking views of the sun setting over the ocean.

opening_hours.notes: Arrive early to secure a good viewing spot.

places.place_tip: Bring a picnic and enjoy the local atmosphere.
